## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the behaviour touched.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under **Unreleased** if a user would notice.
- [ ] `assets/data/*.json` is untouched, or this is the maintainer's export.
- [ ] No published prayer or section `id` was renamed or removed.
- [ ] No verification status was raised without a person checking it against the
      source edition.
- [ ] No new dependency, network call, analytics, or ads.
